verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general programmatic management of products, orders, and customers via REST and GraphQL APIs. That is a developer building block, not a documented bulk or batch operation capability. No cited item mentions batch endpoints, bulk editing, or multi-item updates in a single operation, and community comments about API throttling do not address bulk features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
